decisions.statement: No flag other than the help flag is said on the command line.
The help flag is answered with what a show answers and what a show takes.
The arguments a show takes are read from standard input.
A call piping nothing in is refused rather than run with no argument.
The arguments are read by the reader `akasha change` reads its arguments with.
The key `at` names the path shown.
A path is read against the repository root here.
A path outside the repository is refused.
A call naming no path is refused rather than showing every path.
The body shown is the body the edits kept for this agent would leave.
The body shown is the body the next change appended is handed.
The body shown is not formatted.
The world a change reads is not formatted either.
A path no edit kept names is shown as that path is committed.
A path the edits kept would leave nowhere is refused.
The lines of the body shown are numbered as `akasha read` numbers a body.
A body past what one answer holds is refused rather than broken off partway.
The bytes one answer has are the bytes `akasha read` holds.
The body shown is recorded as read against the calling agent.
The oid recorded is the oid of the committed body.
That oid is the oid `akasha read` records.
The oid of the body shown is recorded as the oid carried.
A path nothing is committed at is recorded under the oid of the body shown.
Nothing here appends an edit.
Nothing here lands.
No turn is taken over the file the edits fill.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A fold the edits kept refuse is a fault of the data.
A body that would not open is an operational fault.
A show whose edits kept will not replay is refused by the edit that went stale.
A key other than `at` is refused rather than passed over.

definition: the command answering the body a path would have once this agent's kept edits land
